name: DNS Lookup
description: Look up records and compare responses and latency across custom DNS servers.

hints.servers: Leave empty to use the system resolvers; when set, only those servers are queried.

faq.a: A single failure does not fail the request; the error is recorded on that server's `error` field.
Yes. Every answer carries its TTL in seconds.

faq.q: May a custom server be an internal address?
faq.a: No. Custom servers go through the same egress guard, so private addresses are blocked.
